title: Coconut rhinoceros beetle detections on Maui
summary: On April 16, 2026, an invasive species program reported finding a dead coconut rhinoceros beetle in one of its traps on April 1st. The chair said that if the budget cannot cover an increase for invasive species work, the program can come back to the administration later. In December 2023, the committee deferred the beetle item after hearing that the state would give Maui some funding and was organizing an incident command system.
